analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI at 55.3 remains in neutral zone, down from 60.2 five days ago. MACD histogram continues to improve at 0.6878, but ADX indicating trend strength is still in a non-trending phase at 19.1. Weekly RSI at 60.0 is bullish, but ADX at 23.3 is in the early stages of trend formation. 4H RSI has turned bearish at 48.6, and MACD histogram is converging negatively at -0.4753. The overall market sentiment is negative at 35 positive vs 65 negative. Overall, current indicators suggest a neutral zone where it is difficult to confirm a buy/sell direction.
